g.text: Hardening & pentest setup for Arch Linux
+# Managed by secure-arch-setup. Remove this file (or run: secure-arch-setup restore) to undo.
+# hide kernel pointers from unprivileged users
+# only root reads the kernel log
+# harden the BPF JIT against spraying
+# processes can only ptrace their children
+# no core dumps from setuid programs
+# block symlink attacks in sticky dirs
+# block FIFO spoofing in sticky dirs
+# block file spoofing in sticky dirs
+# reverse path filtering for new interfaces
+# ignore ICMP redirects on new interfaces
replacing a custom /etc/nftables.conf (a backup is kept)
+# Managed by secure-arch-setup: drop unsolicited inbound traffic, allow everything outbound.
- type filter hook input priority filter
+ type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
+ icmp type { echo-request, destination-unreachable, time-exceeded } limit rate 10/second a
- ct state invalid drop comment "early drop of invalid connections"
- ct state {established, related} accept comment "allow tracked connections"
- iif lo accept comment "allow from loopback"
- meta l4proto { icmp, icmpv6 } accept comment "allow icmp"
- tcp dport ssh accept comment "allow sshd"
- pkttype host limit rate 5/second counter reject with icmpx type admin-prohibited
- type filter hook forward priority filter
+ type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
$ pacman -S --needed --noconfirm whois amass subfinder theharvester recon-ng httpx nuclei
already installed: nikto sqlmap wpscan gobuster zaproxy
$ pacman -S --needed --noconfirm ffuf feroxbuster dirsearch whatweb wfuzz burpsuite
